name: humanitaid-frontend
description: HumanitAID Frontend — site statique + fonctions serverless Vercel

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); fs.rmSync(\"dist\",{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(\"dist\",{recursive:true}); for(const n of fs.readdirSync(\".\")){if([\"dist\",\"node_modules\",\".vercel\",\".env.local\",\".env.production\"].indexOf(n)===-1 && n.endsWith(\".bak\")===false && n.endsWith(\".patch\")===false) fs.cpSync(n,\"dist/\"+n,{recursive:true});} fs.cpSync(\"../admin\",\"dist/admin\",{recursive:true}); console.log(\"Build OK — dist + admin statiques préparés pour Vercel\")"
